method: source-derived statement and explicit lock audit, not a server statement trace
fixture: one legacy identity group, one SQL-writing creation handler; audited events are SQL-free; fresh source streams; no snapshots

guardedIndexedMiss.additionalSql: one bounded identity SELECT after the group fence

guardedIndexedHit.transactionEnd: ROLLBACK; no inline INSERT or post-commit snapshot

command: sorted catalog group FOR SHARE locks
promotion: physical target cutover locks and metadata writes

limitations: Counts describe this fixture's no-conflict execution. Historical streams add hydration pages; snapshots, application handlers, pool setup and asynchronous workers have their own SQL. PostgreSQL also takes ordinary relation/index/constraint locks; these are not enumerated as a total server lock count.
